findings.branch_clone: The initialized/tainted/CS-initialized rejection at301 and pin/CS-ready rejection at321 assign the same STATE result. This is a real required-profile style/structure blocker, not proof that those conditions have wrong results.
findings.null_trace: The analyzer assumes active==NULL at430, then independently selects CONFIG_RX/CONFIG_TX/CONFIG_SPI and reaches active->rx/tx/length. These three errors share one missing explicit active-phase invariant proof.
findings.reachability_limit: No valid public-lifecycle path to NULL active plus CONFIG stage was established in this read-only review. submit sets active/endpoint before CONFIG_SPI under the IRQ guard; initialize starts IDLE; stop with no request enters STOP_RX; FINISH clears active and sets IDLE. Do not label this an already reproduced public-API crash or a compiler/tool failure.
findings.cleanup_constraint: NULL active is legitimate during cold retained cleanup and STOP_RX..FINISH. A blanket service-return for active==NULL would break rollback/stop. Missing-active active phases must not fabricate SETTLED, erase owner responsibility, or silently release controller/System clocks.
